title: PROTAGONIST
use_cases: Use when drafting initial character profiles and backstories
Configure when defining the psychological motivations and internal conflicts of a lead character
Implement when outlining character arcs to ensure growth from a false belief to a realized truth
Use when developing unique dialogue patterns and physical habits for character distinctness
Configure when mapping relationships between the protagonist and supporting cast
